title: Lifelog
tagline: the go-to app when you want to keep a record of those special moments that make up your life. It's like your personal diary, but way cooler because it stores everything securely on the blockchain.
description: the go-to app when you want to keep a record of those special moments that make up your life. It's like your personal diary, but way cooler because it stores everything securely on the blockchain. All you have to do is open the app, and with a few taps, you can capture and store your memories. Type in a quick description and Boom! Your life event is logged and saved.
how_its_made: We utilized Cometh, a platform that enables smooth connectivity for users' wallets, to facilitate wallet creation and connection. We leveraged Scroll and NFTs to build the app. This combination allowed users to seamlessly interact with the blockchain and securely publish their short life logs directly on-chain.
